intent.goal: Cancel a settled sale by compensating financial and stock effects exactly once.
invariants: compensation may execute at most once per original effect
cancel must not create net stock gain beyond restoration

postconditions: original stock quantity restored exactly once

logs: payment provider deduplicated reversal by external id
stock restoration applied locally on each invocation
observable_input.error: Compensation invariant failed: restored stock exceeds original sold quantity by 5.

gold_codemanager.thesis: RestoreStock lacks compensation idempotency keyed to the original sale effect, so retry after settlement uncertainty re-applies the restoration.
gold_codemanager.mechanism: The payment side is deduplicated while stock is restored twice for the same sale_id; the duplicate appears only after retry following settlement timeout.
causal_chain: RestoreStock cannot identify the already-realized compensation.
A second +5 is applied and stock exceeds the original quantity.
falsification_criteria: If the first restore was not committed, reject this thesis.
If the two attempts refer to different original stock effects, reject this thesis.
gold_codemanager.solution_request: Modify only Commerce.RestoreStock/implementation.zig. Make compensation replay idempotent with respect to the original sale effect and explain why the change prevents a second restoration without blocking legitimate restoration of a different sale.

gold_solution.causal_explanation: The causal defect is replay of a realized compensating effect without stable identity. Settlement uncertainty causes the same compensation to be invoked twice, and local stock mutation has no deduplication boundary.
gold_solution.proposed_change: Bind restoration to a stable compensation identity derived from the original sale stock effect, atomically detecting prior realization before applying the delta.
gold_solution.predicted_effect: Retrying cancellation for S-91 preserves a single +5 restoration while different sales remain independent.
risks: identity must refer to the original effect rather than mutable request data
check and mutation must be atomic
verification: restart between effect and acknowledgement remains safe

intent.goal: Synchronize remote catalog updates without overwhelming the provider.
invariants: retry policy is governed by core configuration
Action semantics must not change provider backoff policy

actions.description: Fetch a catalog page from an external provider.

logs: Action returned typed transient rate_limited error each time
core retry policy ignored provider retry-after metadata by configuration
observable_input.error: Catalog sync exhausted retries while provider continued rate limiting.

gold_codemanager.thesis: The retry storm is caused by a core retry policy whose backoff is incompatible with the provider's declared retry window, not by FetchCatalogPage implementation.
gold_codemanager.mechanism: The Action consistently surfaces the correct typed transient error and provider retry-after value; runtime retries at 50/100/200ms, all far below 2000ms.
causal_chain: Provider rate limits and declares a 2000ms retry window.
Action reports the transient condition correctly.
Core retry configuration schedules retries much earlier.
Each retry hits the same provider limit.
Configured retry count is exhausted without giving the condition time to clear.
falsification_criteria: If FetchCatalogPage discards or misreports retry-after metadata required by contract, reconsider as code fault.
If core backoff already respects >=2000ms, reject this thesis.
alternative_causes: incorrect clock units in runtime scheduler
gold_codemanager.solution_request: Do not patch implementation.zig. Route to SystemHealerAgent and constrain the change to configs/core.yml. Require an explanation linking configured retry timing to repeated 429 responses and preserving retry safety bounds.

gold_solution.causal_explanation: The evidence isolates the failure to retry timing: the Action behaves correctly, but system policy retries before the provider's recovery window can elapse.
gold_solution.proposed_change: Adjust the healable retry/backoff policy in configs/core.yml so transient provider throttling is retried no earlier than the allowed window, within configured maximum delay limits.
gold_solution.predicted_effect: Retries stop hammering the provider inside the same throttle window and can succeed once the allowed interval passes.
risks: excessive backoff may violate synchronization SLO
provider hints must remain bounded by local policy
verification: retry spacing satisfies policy and provider window
permanent errors still fail without inappropriate retries

intent.goal: Apply product change events so the read projection monotonically reflects entity version.
invariants: older events may be replayed but must not overwrite newer state

actions.description: Apply one product event to the read model.
postconditions: projection is at least as new as the event ordering law permits

traces: apply event v18 write projection version=18
late delivery event v17 write projection version=17
observable_input.error: Projection monotonicity violated: version decreased from 18 to 17.

gold_codemanager.thesis: ApplyProductProjection performs an unconditional entity upsert and does not reject stale event versions, so out-of-order delivery can regress the projection.
gold_codemanager.mechanism: The trace shows v18 committed first and v17 arriving later; the projection then becomes 17, exactly matching unconditional overwrite behavior.
causal_chain: Implementation does not compare incoming and stored versions.
falsification_criteria: If writes are already conditional on incoming_version > stored_version, reject this thesis.
If the final version 17 came from a separate entity identity, reject this thesis.
alternative_causes: read metric observed a stale replica rather than the written projection
gold_codemanager.solution_request: Modify only Commerce.ApplyProductProjection/implementation.zig. Prevent stale event versions from regressing state while preserving safe replay. Explain how the version condition interrupts the observed causal chain.

gold_solution.causal_explanation: Out-of-order delivery is expected, but unconditional upsert converts delivery order into state authority. The later-arriving older event should be treated as stale, not as a new state.
gold_solution.proposed_change: Make projection update conditional on the incoming version being newer than the stored version, treating equal/older versions as idempotent stale replays according to the contract.
gold_solution.predicted_effect: After v18 is applied, a late v17 cannot reduce the projection version or overwrite newer fields.
risks: version comparison must be atomic with write
partial field-merging semantics must remain consistent with event contract
verification: late older event cannot regress state

intent.goal: Generate and persist a sale receipt after settlement.
invariants: receipt must correspond to the settled sale
unknown failures must not trigger speculative mutation without sufficient evidence

actions.description: Render deterministic receipt bytes from settled sale data.

logs: no previous occurrence for this target
observable_input.error: StoreReceipt failed with generic EIO; no additional diagnostics available.

gold_codemanager.thesis: The current evidence establishes that failure occurs during StoreReceipt I/O but is insufficient to distinguish an implementation defect from an underlying transient/storage-system fault.
gold_codemanager.mechanism: A generic EIO after open identifies the failing boundary but provides no discriminating evidence about request construction, filesystem state, device error, or runtime configuration.
causal_chain: The storage layer returns generic EIO.
No evidence currently identifies why that I/O failed.
falsification_criteria: Any thesis assigning a specific code cause is premature until reproducible evidence distinguishes it from system/storage failure.
gold_codemanager.solution_request: Do not request a mutation yet. Ask the Runtime for a bounded diagnostic replay or additional storage evidence sufficient to discriminate code fault from system fault. Preserve both implementation.zig and configs/core.yml until the hypothesis becomes falsifiable.

gold_solution.causal_explanation: No causal implementation solution is justified by the available evidence. A patch would be speculative because EIO is compatible with multiple code and system causes.
gold_solution.proposed_change: No mutation. Acquire discriminating evidence through controlled replay/diagnostics, then formulate a new HealingHypothesis.
gold_solution.predicted_effect: Avoids converting uncertainty into an arbitrary code/config change and preserves causal attribution for the next experiment.
risks: diagnostics must remain bounded and not expose hidden acceptance internals
verification: no unauthorized mutation occurs before classification
